title: WhatsApp
subtitle: The channel your clients already use. Connect your number and let reminders go out on their own.

connection.title: Your WhatsApp number
connection.lead: Messages go out under your barbershop's name, from your own number. Clients reply to you.
connection.disconnectConfirm: This removes your Meta credentials. Your conversations are NOT deleted and you can reconnect any time.
connection.unavailable: The Meta connection is not configured on the server yet. Write to us and we'll set it up.

state.NO_PAYMENT_METHOD: Your Meta account needs a payment method
state.ERROR: There's a problem with the connection

help.DISCONNECTED: Connect the number you already use with your clients. You can keep using it on your phone with the WhatsApp Business app.
help.CONNECTED: All set. Reminders go out on their own and replies land here.
help.UNVERIFIED: This is NOT a problem: without verification you can message up to 250 different clients every 24 hours — plenty for a barbershop. Verifying your business with Meta is optional and only matters if you ever need more.
help.NO_PAYMENT_METHOD: Meta charges messages to your own WhatsApp Business account. Add a card there and messages start flowing again.
help.ERROR: Reconnect your WhatsApp to renew the permission.

quota.title: Messages this period
quota.near: You've used 80% of the messages included this period. Nothing is cut off yet, but it's worth knowing.
quota.exhausted: You've used all the messages included this period. Anything queued goes out when the next one starts; upgrade if you need more now.
quota.cost: Meta charges your account about {price} USD per delivered reminder. Three hundred appointments a month costs under 3 USD.

templates.title: Templates approved by Meta
templates.lead: Outside the 24 hours after your client's last message, WhatsApp only allows an approved template. We register them in your account for you.
templates.includeMarketing: Also include promotional ones (birthdays and "we miss you")
templates.marketingWarn: Promotional templates cost about 4x a reminder and your client can block that kind of message. They never go out on their own.
templates.created: {count} registered. Meta reviews them, usually within minutes.

inbox.title: Conversations
inbox.empty: No conversations yet. As soon as a client writes to you, it shows up here.
inbox.archiveNote: Archiving deletes nothing: if the client writes again, the conversation comes back on its own.
inbox.pickThread: Pick a conversation to read it.
inbox.windowClosed: More than 24 hours have passed since this client's last message. WhatsApp only allows writing first with an approved template.
inbox.windowOpen: You can reply freely for the next 24 hours.
inbox.unknownClient: Number with no client on file
inbox.attachmentExpired: This file is no longer available: WhatsApp deletes them after 30 days.

outbox.title: Waiting to go out
outbox.lead: Reminders are scheduled and sent automatically. If you want to hurry them along, here you go.
outbox.cronMissing: Automatic sending is not scheduled on the server yet. In the meantime, this button does the same thing.

campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.lead: These are promotional messages: they cost about 4x a reminder and your client can block them. That's why they never go out on their own.
campaign.estimated: Estimated cost: {usd} USD ({unit} USD per message)
campaign.promoHint: One line. It's added at the end of the message.
campaign.promoPlaceholder: This month your cut comes with a free beard trim.
campaign.none: Right now there's no one to write to.
campaign.templateMissing: First register the promotional template in the Templates tab and wait for Meta to approve it.
campaign.batch: They go out {max} at a time so we can tell you what happened with each one.

errors.noPermission: You don't have permission to see the barbershop's WhatsApp.
errors.planLocked: Your plan doesn't include the WhatsApp inbox. Reminders are included.
